/*==============================================================================
  4) MasterReport
==============================================================================*/
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE Manutencao.PC_IndexAdvisor_MasterReport
(
      @TargetDatabase SYSNAME
    , @PlanDate DATE = NULL
    , @TopIndexes INT = 50
    , @TopStats INT = 50
    , @TopConfigs INT = 20
    , @OnlyPending BIT = 1
)
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    SET @TargetDatabase = NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(@TargetDatabase)), N'');

    IF @TargetDatabase IS NULL
    BEGIN
        RAISERROR(N'@TargetDatabase est vazio.', 16, 1);
        RETURN;
    END;

    IF @PlanDate IS NULL
        SET @PlanDate = CONVERT(date, GETDATE());

    DECLARE
        @LastSnapshotId BIGINT,
        @LastCapturedAt DATETIME2(0),
        @HasDbConfigSnapshot BIT = 0,
        @HasIndexSnapshot BIT = 0,
        @HasStatsSnapshot BIT = 0;

    SELECT TOP (1)
        @LastSnapshotId = [e].[SnapshotId],
        @LastCapturedAt = [e].[CapturedAt]
    FROM Manutencao.IndexAdvisor_EnvironmentSnapshot AS [e]
    WHERE [e].[TargetDatabaseName] = @TargetDatabase
    ORDER BY [e].[SnapshotId] DESC;

    IF @LastSnapshotId IS NULL
    BEGIN
        RAISERROR(N'Nenhum snapshot encontrado para %s.',16,1,@TargetDatabase);
        RETURN;
    END;

    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT 1
        FROM Manutencao.IndexAdvisor_IndexSnapshot
        WHERE [TargetDatabaseName] = @TargetDatabase
          AND [SnapshotId] = @LastSnapshotId
    ) SET @HasIndexSnapshot = 1;

    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT 1
        FROM Manutencao.IndexAdvisor_StatsSnapshot
        WHERE [TargetDatabaseName] = @TargetDatabase
          AND [SnapshotId] = @LastSnapshotId
    ) SET @HasStatsSnapshot = 1;

    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT 1
        FROM Manutencao.IndexAdvisor_DbConfigSnapshot
        WHERE [TargetDatabaseName] = @TargetDatabase
          AND [SnapshotId] = @LastSnapshotId
    ) SET @HasDbConfigSnapshot = 1;

    SELECT
        [GridName] = N'0) Documentao',
        [Analysis] = N'Estrutura do relatrio',
        [Description] = N'1=Ambiente, 2=Resumo ndice, 3=Plano ndice, 4=Plano stats, 5=Plano config, 6=Index review, 7=Resumo final.';

    SELECT TOP (1)
        [TargetDatabaseName] = [e].[TargetDatabaseName],
        [SnapshotId] = [e].[SnapshotId],
        [CapturedAt] = [e].[CapturedAt],
        [DbCompatibility] = [e].[DbCompatibility],
        [Edition] = [e].[Edition],
        [ProductVersion] = [e].[ProductVersion],
        [EngineEdition] = [e].[EngineEdition],
        [CpuCount] = [e].[CpuCount],
        [HyperthreadRatio] = [e].[HyperthreadRatio],
        [PhysicalMemoryMB] = [e].[PhysicalMemoryMB],
        [AvailableMemoryMB] = [e].[AvailableMemoryMB],
        [SqlServerStartTime] = [e].[SqlServerStartTime],
        [TempdbDataFiles] = [e].[TempdbDataFiles],
        [TempdbTotalMB] = [e].[TempdbTotalMB],
        [TempdbFreeMB] = [e].[TempdbFreeMB],
        [TempdbImbalancePct] = [e].[TempdbImbalancePct],
        [TempdbWriteLatencyMs] = [e].[TempdbWriteLatencyMs],
        [TempdbReadLatencyMs] = [e].[TempdbReadLatencyMs],
        [DbWriteLatencyMs] = [e].[DbWriteLatencyMs],
        [DbReadLatencyMs] = [e].[DbReadLatencyMs],
        [TempdbPagelatchWaitingTasks] = [e].[TempdbPagelatchWaitingTasks],
        [PhysicalStatsModeUsed] = [e].[PhysicalStatsModeUsed],
        [IsBusinessHours] = [e].[IsBusinessHours],
        [HasIndexSnapshot] = @HasIndexSnapshot,
        [HasStatsSnapshot] = @HasStatsSnapshot,
        [HasDbConfigSnapshot] = @HasDbConfigSnapshot
    FROM Manutencao.IndexAdvisor_EnvironmentSnapshot AS [e]
    WHERE [e].[SnapshotId] = @LastSnapshotId;

    SELECT
        [TargetDatabaseName] = @TargetDatabase,
        [SnapshotId] = @LastSnapshotId,
        [CapturedAt] = @LastCapturedAt,
        [TotalIndexes] = COUNT(*),
        [TableIndexes] = SUM(CASE WHEN [i].[ObjectType]='U' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
        [ViewIndexes] = SUM(CASE WHEN [i].[ObjectType]='V' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
        [IndexesWithFragData] = SUM(CASE WHEN [i].[AvgFragmentationInPercent] IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
        [IndexesStatsStale] = SUM(CASE WHEN [i].[StatsStale] = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
        [LargeIndexesOver512MB] = SUM(CASE WHEN ISNULL([i].[IndexSizeMB],0) >= 512 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
        [WriteHeavyIndexes] = SUM(CASE WHEN ISNULL([i].[Writes],0) >= 50000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
        [ReadHeavyIndexes] = SUM(CASE WHEN ISNULL([i].[Reads],0) > ISNULL([i].[Writes],0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
    FROM Manutencao.IndexAdvisor_IndexSnapshot AS [i]
    WHERE [i].[TargetDatabaseName] = @TargetDatabase
      AND [i].[SnapshotId] = @LastSnapshotId;

    SELECT TOP (@TopIndexes)
        [PlanDate],[TargetDatabaseName],[SnapshotId],[ObjectType],[SchemaName],[ObjectName],[IndexName],
        [IndexId],[PartitionNumber],[PageCount],[IndexSizeMB],[AvgFragmentationInPercent],
        [CurrentFillFactor],[CurrentPadIndex],[CurrentAllowPageLocks],[CurrentAllowRowLocks],[CurrentCompression],
        [Rec_Action],[Rec_FillFactor],[Rec_PadIndex],[Rec_AllowPageLocks],[Rec_AllowRowLocks],
        [Rec_DataCompression],[Rec_SortInTempdb],[Rec_MaxDop],
        [PriorityScore],[Status],[Reason],[SuggestedScript]
    FROM Manutencao.IndexAdvisor_IndexPlanQueue
    WHERE [TargetDatabaseName] = @TargetDatabase
      AND [PlanDate] = @PlanDate
      AND (@OnlyPending = 0 OR [Status] = N'PENDING')
    ORDER BY [PriorityScore] DESC, [SchemaName], [ObjectName], [IndexName];

    SELECT TOP (@TopStats)
        [PlanDate],[TargetDatabaseName],[SnapshotId],[ObjectType],[SchemaName],[ObjectName],[StatsName],[StatsId],
        [StatsType],[IsFromIndex],[RelatedIndexName],[RowCount],[ModificationCounter],[ModificationPct],[LastUpdated],
        [ObjectSizeMB],[Rec_Action],[Rec_Sampling],[PriorityScore],[Status],[Reason],[SuggestedScript]
    FROM Manutencao.IndexAdvisor_StatsPlanQueue
    WHERE [TargetDatabaseName] = @TargetDatabase
      AND [PlanDate] = @PlanDate
      AND (@OnlyPending = 0 OR [Status] = N'PENDING')
    ORDER BY [PriorityScore] DESC, [SchemaName], [ObjectName], [StatsName];

    SELECT TOP (@TopConfigs)
        [PlanDate],[TargetDatabaseName],[SnapshotId],[ConfigName],[CurrentValue],[RecommendedValue],
        [Classification],[PriorityScore],[Status],[Reason],[SuggestedScript]
    FROM Manutencao.IndexAdvisor_DbConfigPlan
    WHERE [TargetDatabaseName] = @TargetDatabase
      AND [PlanDate] = @PlanDate
      AND (@OnlyPending = 0 OR [Status] = N'PENDING')
    ORDER BY [PriorityScore] DESC, [ConfigName];

    SELECT
        [ReviewType],[SchemaName],[ObjectName],[IndexName],[RelatedIndexName],
        [Reads],[Writes],[IndexSizeMB],[Classification],[Reason],[SuggestedAction]
    FROM Manutencao.IndexAdvisor_IndexReview
    WHERE [TargetDatabaseName] = @TargetDatabase
      AND [PlanDate] = @PlanDate
      AND [SnapshotId] = @LastSnapshotId
    ORDER BY [ReviewType],[SchemaName],[ObjectName],[IndexName];

    SELECT
        [TargetDatabaseName] = @TargetDatabase,
        [PlanDate] = @PlanDate,
        [LastSnapshotId] = @LastSnapshotId,
        [LastCapturedAt] = @LastCapturedAt,
        [PendingIndexActions] =
            (
                SELECT COUNT(*)
                FROM Manutencao.IndexAdvisor_IndexPlanQueue
                WHERE [TargetDatabaseName] = @TargetDatabase
                  AND [PlanDate] = @PlanDate
                  AND [Status] = N'PENDING'
            ),
        [PendingStatsActions] =
            (
                SELECT COUNT(*)
                FROM Manutencao.IndexAdvisor_StatsPlanQueue
                WHERE [TargetDatabaseName] = @TargetDatabase
                  AND [PlanDate] = @PlanDate
                  AND [Status] = N'PENDING'
            ),
        [PendingDbConfigActions] =
            (
                SELECT COUNT(*)
                FROM Manutencao.IndexAdvisor_DbConfigPlan
                WHERE [TargetDatabaseName] = @TargetDatabase
                  AND [PlanDate] = @PlanDate
                  AND [Status] = N'PENDING'
            ),
        [HighestIndexPriority] =
            (
                SELECT ISNULL(MAX([PriorityScore]),0)
                FROM Manutencao.IndexAdvisor_IndexPlanQueue
                WHERE [TargetDatabaseName] = @TargetDatabase
                  AND [PlanDate] = @PlanDate
                  AND (@OnlyPending = 0 OR [Status] = N'PENDING')
            ),
        [HighestStatsPriority] =
            (
                SELECT ISNULL(MAX([PriorityScore]),0)
                FROM Manutencao.IndexAdvisor_StatsPlanQueue
                WHERE [TargetDatabaseName] = @TargetDatabase
                  AND [PlanDate] = @PlanDate
                  AND (@OnlyPending = 0 OR [Status] = N'PENDING')
            ),
        [HighestDbConfigPriority] =
            (
                SELECT ISNULL(MAX([PriorityScore]),0)
                FROM Manutencao.IndexAdvisor_DbConfigPlan
                WHERE [TargetDatabaseName] = @TargetDatabase
                  AND [PlanDate] = @PlanDate
                  AND (@OnlyPending = 0 OR [Status] = N'PENDING')
            );
END
GO

/*==============================================================================
  5) CleanupHistory
==============================================================================*/
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE Manutencao.PC_IndexAdvisor_CleanupHistory
(
    @TargetDatabase SYSNAME = NULL,
    @Debug BIT = 0
)
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    DECLARE
        @KeepDays_EnvironmentSnapshot INT = 90,
        @KeepDays_IndexSnapshot INT = 60,
        @KeepDays_StatsSnapshot INT = 60,
        @KeepDays_IndexPlan INT = 60,
        @KeepDays_StatsPlan INT = 60,
        @KeepDays_DbConfigPlan INT = 60;

    IF @TargetDatabase IS NOT NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT TOP (1)
            @KeepDays_EnvironmentSnapshot = [KeepDays_EnvironmentSnapshot],
            @KeepDays_IndexSnapshot = [KeepDays_IndexSnapshot],
            @KeepDays_StatsSnapshot = [KeepDays_StatsSnapshot],
            @KeepDays_IndexPlan = [KeepDays_IndexPlan],
            @KeepDays_StatsPlan = [KeepDays_StatsPlan],
            @KeepDays_DbConfigPlan = [KeepDays_DbConfigPlan]
        FROM Manutencao.IndexAdvisor_Config
        WHERE [TargetDatabaseName] = @TargetDatabase;
    END;

    DECLARE
        @CutoffEnv DATETIME2(0) = DATEADD(DAY, -@KeepDays_EnvironmentSnapshot, SYSUTCDATETIME()),
        @CutoffIdx DATETIME2(0) = DATEADD(DAY, -@KeepDays_IndexSnapshot, SYSUTCDATETIME()),
        @CutoffStats DATETIME2(0) = DATEADD(DAY, -@KeepDays_StatsSnapshot, SYSUTCDATETIME()),
        @CutoffIndexPlan DATE = DATEADD(DAY, -@KeepDays_IndexPlan, CONVERT(date, SYSUTCDATETIME())),
        @CutoffStatsPlan DATE = DATEADD(DAY, -@KeepDays_StatsPlan, CONVERT(date, SYSUTCDATETIME())),
        @CutoffDbConfigPlan DATE = DATEADD(DAY, -@KeepDays_DbConfigPlan, CONVERT(date, SYSUTCDATETIME()));

    IF @Debug = 1
    BEGIN
        SELECT
            [TargetDatabase] = @TargetDatabase,
            [CutoffEnv] = @CutoffEnv,
            [CutoffIdx] = @CutoffIdx,
            [CutoffStats] = @CutoffStats,
            [CutoffIndexPlan] = @CutoffIndexPlan,
            [CutoffStatsPlan] = @CutoffStatsPlan,
            [CutoffDbConfigPlan] = @CutoffDbConfigPlan;
        RETURN;
    END;

    DELETE FROM Manutencao.IndexAdvisor_IndexReview
    WHERE [PlanDate] < @CutoffIndexPlan
      AND (@TargetDatabase IS NULL OR [TargetDatabaseName] = @TargetDatabase);

    DELETE FROM Manutencao.IndexAdvisor_IndexPlanQueue
    WHERE [PlanDate] < @CutoffIndexPlan
      AND (@TargetDatabase IS NULL OR [TargetDatabaseName] = @TargetDatabase);

    DELETE FROM Manutencao.IndexAdvisor_StatsPlanQueue
    WHERE [PlanDate] < @CutoffStatsPlan
      AND (@TargetDatabase IS NULL OR [TargetDatabaseName] = @TargetDatabase);

    DELETE FROM Manutencao.IndexAdvisor_DbConfigPlan
    WHERE [PlanDate] < @CutoffDbConfigPlan
      AND (@TargetDatabase IS NULL OR [TargetDatabaseName] = @TargetDatabase);

    DELETE FROM Manutencao.IndexAdvisor_IndexSnapshot
    WHERE [CapturedAt] < @CutoffIdx
      AND (@TargetDatabase IS NULL OR [TargetDatabaseName] = @TargetDatabase);

    DELETE FROM Manutencao.IndexAdvisor_StatsSnapshot
    WHERE [CapturedAt] < @CutoffStats
      AND (@TargetDatabase IS NULL OR [TargetDatabaseName] = @TargetDatabase);

    DELETE FROM Manutencao.IndexAdvisor_DbConfigSnapshot
    WHERE [CapturedAt] < @CutoffEnv
      AND (@TargetDatabase IS NULL OR [TargetDatabaseName] = @TargetDatabase);

    DELETE FROM Manutencao.IndexAdvisor_EnvironmentSnapshot
    WHERE [CapturedAt] < @CutoffEnv
      AND (@TargetDatabase IS NULL OR [TargetDatabaseName] = @TargetDatabase);
END
GO

CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE Manutencao.PC_IndexAdvisor_RunCore
(
      @TargetDatabase SYSNAME
    , @ManutencaoDatabase SYSNAME = NULL
    , @IsBusinessHours BIT = 0
    , @UsePhysicalStatsMode NVARCHAR(10) = N'LIMITED'
    , @CollectOperationalStats BIT = 0
    , @PlanDate DATE = NULL
    , @QueuePlan BIT = 1
    , @QueueRedundantReview BIT = 1
    , @Debug BIT = 0
)
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    SET @TargetDatabase = NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(@TargetDatabase)), N'');
    SET @ManutencaoDatabase = NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(@ManutencaoDatabase)), N'');

    IF @TargetDatabase IS NULL
    BEGIN
        RAISERROR(N'@TargetDatabase est vazio.',16,1);
        RETURN;
    END;

    IF DB_ID(@TargetDatabase) IS NULL
    BEGIN
        RAISERROR(N'Database alvo no existe: %s',16,1,@TargetDatabase);
        RETURN;
    END;

    IF @ManutencaoDatabase IS NULL
        SET @ManutencaoDatabase = DB_NAME();

    IF @PlanDate IS NULL
        SET @PlanDate = CONVERT(date, GETDATE());

    EXEC Manutencao.PC_IndexAdvisor_CollectSnapshot
         @TargetDatabase = @TargetDatabase,
         @ManutencaoDatabase = @ManutencaoDatabase,
         @UsePhysicalStatsMode = @UsePhysicalStatsMode,
         @IsBusinessHours = @IsBusinessHours,
         @CollectOperationalStats = @CollectOperationalStats,
         @Debug = @Debug;

    DECLARE
          @SnapshotId BIGINT
        , @StatsSnapshotId BIGINT;

    /* pega o ltimo snapshot vlido de ndices */
    SELECT TOP (1)
        @SnapshotId = e.[SnapshotId]
    FROM Manutencao.IndexAdvisor_EnvironmentSnapshot e
    WHERE e.[TargetDatabaseName] = @TargetDatabase
      AND EXISTS
      (
          SELECT 1
          FROM Manutencao.IndexAdvisor_IndexSnapshot i
          WHERE i.[TargetDatabaseName] = e.[TargetDatabaseName]
            AND i.[SnapshotId] = e.[SnapshotId]
      )
    ORDER BY e.[SnapshotId] DESC;

    IF @SnapshotId IS NULL
    BEGIN
        RAISERROR(N'CollectSnapshot executou, mas no foi encontrado SnapshotId vlido em IndexSnapshot para %s.',16,1,@TargetDatabase);
        RETURN;
    END;

    EXEC Manutencao.PC_IndexAdvisor_CollectStatsSnapshot
         @TargetDatabase = @TargetDatabase,
         @ManutencaoDatabase = @ManutencaoDatabase,
         @SnapshotId = @SnapshotId,
         @Debug = @Debug;

    /* confirma que stats snapshot existe para o mesmo snapshot */
    SELECT TOP (1)
        @StatsSnapshotId = e.[SnapshotId]
    FROM Manutencao.IndexAdvisor_EnvironmentSnapshot e
    WHERE e.[TargetDatabaseName] = @TargetDatabase
      AND e.[SnapshotId] = @SnapshotId
      AND EXISTS
      (
          SELECT 1
          FROM Manutencao.IndexAdvisor_StatsSnapshot s
          WHERE s.[TargetDatabaseName] = e.[TargetDatabaseName]
            AND s.[SnapshotId] = e.[SnapshotId]
      )
    ORDER BY e.[SnapshotId] DESC;

    IF @StatsSnapshotId IS NULL
    BEGIN
        RAISERROR(N'O SnapshotId=%I64d foi gerado para ndices, mas no ficou vlido em StatsSnapshot para %s.',16,1,@SnapshotId,@TargetDatabase);
        RETURN;
    END;

    EXEC Manutencao.PC_IndexAdvisor_GenerateIndexPlan
         @TargetDatabase = @TargetDatabase,
         @ManutencaoDatabase = @ManutencaoDatabase,
         @PlanDate = @PlanDate,
         @SnapshotId = @SnapshotId,
         @QueuePlan = @QueuePlan,
         @Debug = @Debug;

    EXEC Manutencao.PC_IndexAdvisor_GenerateStatsPlan
         @TargetDatabase = @TargetDatabase,
         @PlanDate = @PlanDate,
         @SnapshotId = @SnapshotId,
         @QueuePlan = @QueuePlan,
         @Debug = @Debug;

    EXEC Manutencao.PC_IndexAdvisor_GenerateRedundantIndexReview
         @TargetDatabase = @TargetDatabase,
         @PlanDate = @PlanDate,
         @SnapshotId = @SnapshotId,
         @QueueReview = @QueueRedundantReview,
         @Debug = @Debug;

    SELECT
          [Mode] = N'CORE_'
        , [TargetDatabase] = @TargetDatabase
        , [PlanDate] = @PlanDate
        , [SnapshotId] = @SnapshotId
        , [UsePhysicalStatsMode] = @UsePhysicalStatsMode
        , [IsBusinessHours] = @IsBusinessHours
        , [CollectOperationalStats] = @CollectOperationalStats
        , [IndexPlanPending] =
            (
                SELECT COUNT(*)
                FROM Manutencao.IndexAdvisor_IndexPlanQueue
                WHERE [TargetDatabaseName] = @TargetDatabase
                  AND [PlanDate] = @PlanDate
                  AND [SnapshotId] = @SnapshotId
                  AND [Status] = N'PENDING'
            )
        , [StatsPlanPending] =
            (
                SELECT COUNT(*)
                FROM Manutencao.IndexAdvisor_StatsPlanQueue
                WHERE [TargetDatabaseName] = @TargetDatabase
                  AND [PlanDate] = @PlanDate
                  AND [SnapshotId] = @SnapshotId
                  AND [Status] = N'PENDING'
            )
        , [RedundantReviewPending] =
            (
                SELECT COUNT(*)
                FROM Manutencao.IndexAdvisor_RedundantIndexReview
                WHERE [TargetDatabaseName] = @TargetDatabase
                  AND [PlanDate] = @PlanDate
                  AND [SnapshotId] = @SnapshotId
                  AND [Status] = N'PENDING'
            );
END

CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE Manutencao.PC_IndexAdvisor_GenerateRedundantIndexReview
(
      @TargetDatabase SYSNAME
    , @PlanDate DATE = NULL
    , @SnapshotId BIGINT = NULL
    , @QueueReview BIT = 1
    , @Debug BIT = 0
)
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    SET @TargetDatabase = NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(@TargetDatabase)), N'');

    IF @TargetDatabase IS NULL
    BEGIN
        RAISERROR(N'@TargetDatabase est vazio.', 16, 1);
        RETURN;
    END;

    IF @PlanDate IS NULL
        SET @PlanDate = CONVERT(date, GETDATE());

    IF @SnapshotId IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT TOP (1) @SnapshotId = [SnapshotId]
        FROM Manutencao.IndexAdvisor_EnvironmentSnapshot
        WHERE [TargetDatabaseName] = @TargetDatabase
        ORDER BY [SnapshotId] DESC;
    END;

    IF @SnapshotId IS NULL
    BEGIN
        RAISERROR(N'Nenhum SnapshotId encontrado para %s.', 16, 1, @TargetDatabase);
        RETURN;
    END;

    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#idx') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #idx;
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#pairs') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #pairs;
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#review') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #review;

    CREATE TABLE #idx
    (
          [SchemaName] SYSNAME NOT NULL
        , [ObjectName] SYSNAME NOT NULL
        , [ObjectId] INT NOT NULL
        , [IndexId] INT NOT NULL
        , [IndexName] SYSNAME NOT NULL
        , [IndexTypeDesc] NVARCHAR(60) NULL
        , [IsUnique] BIT NOT NULL
        , [IsPrimaryKey] BIT NOT NULL
        , [HasFilter] BIT NOT NULL
        , [FilterDefinition] NVARCHAR(MAX) NULL
        , [Reads] BIGINT NULL
        , [Writes] BIGINT NULL
        , [PageCount] BIGINT NULL
        , [IndexSizeMB] DECIMAL(19,2) NULL
        , [KeyColumns] NVARCHAR(MAX) NULL
        , [IncludeColumns] NVARCHAR(MAX) NULL
    );

    ;WITH base AS
    (
        SELECT
              i.[SchemaName]
            , i.[ObjectName]
            , i.[ObjectId]
            , i.[IndexId]
            , i.[IndexName]
            , i.[IndexTypeDesc]
            , i.[IsUnique]
            , i.[IsPrimaryKey]
            , i.[HasFilter]
            , i.[FilterDefinition]
            , i.[Reads]
            , i.[Writes]
            , i.[PageCount]
            , i.[IndexSizeMB]
        FROM Manutencao.IndexAdvisor_IndexSnapshot i
        WHERE i.[TargetDatabaseName] = @TargetDatabase
          AND i.[SnapshotId] = @SnapshotId
          AND i.[ObjectType] = 'U'
          AND i.[IndexId] > 0
          AND i.[IndexName] IS NOT NULL
          AND i.[IndexName] NOT LIKE N'<%'
    ),
    ic AS
    (
        SELECT
              s.[SchemaName]
            , s.[ObjectName]
            , s.[ObjectId]
            , s.[IndexId]
            , s.[IndexName]
            , s.[IndexTypeDesc]
            , s.[IsUnique]
            , s.[IsPrimaryKey]
            , s.[HasFilter]
            , s.[FilterDefinition]
            , s.[Reads]
            , s.[Writes]
            , s.[PageCount]
            , s.[IndexSizeMB]
            , [KeyColumns] =
                STUFF
                (
                    (
                        SELECT
                            N',' + QUOTENAME(c.[name])
                        FROM sys.index_columns ic2
                        JOIN sys.columns c
                          ON c.[object_id] = ic2.[object_id]
                         AND c.[column_id] = ic2.[column_id]
                        WHERE ic2.[object_id] = s.[ObjectId]
                          AND ic2.[index_id] = s.[IndexId]
                          AND ic2.[is_included_column] = 0
                        ORDER BY ic2.[key_ordinal], ic2.[index_column_id]
                        FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE
                    ).value('.', 'nvarchar(max)')
                , 1, 1, N'')
            , [IncludeColumns] =
                STUFF
                (
                    (
                        SELECT
                            N',' + QUOTENAME(c.[name])
                        FROM sys.index_columns ic3
                        JOIN sys.columns c
                          ON c.[object_id] = ic3.[object_id]
                         AND c.[column_id] = ic3.[column_id]
                        WHERE ic3.[object_id] = s.[ObjectId]
                          AND ic3.[index_id] = s.[IndexId]
                          AND ic3.[is_included_column] = 1
                        ORDER BY ic3.[index_column_id]
                        FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE
                    ).value('.', 'nvarchar(max)')
                , 1, 1, N'')
        FROM base s
        WHERE OBJECT_ID(QUOTENAME(s.[SchemaName]) + N'.' + QUOTENAME(s.[ObjectName])) IS NOT NULL
    )
    INSERT #idx
    (
          [SchemaName],[ObjectName],[ObjectId],[IndexId],[IndexName],[IndexTypeDesc]
        , [IsUnique],[IsPrimaryKey],[HasFilter],[FilterDefinition]
        , [Reads],[Writes],[PageCount],[IndexSizeMB]
        , [KeyColumns],[IncludeColumns]
    )
    SELECT
          [SchemaName],[ObjectName],[ObjectId],[IndexId],[IndexName],[IndexTypeDesc]
        , [IsUnique],[IsPrimaryKey],[HasFilter],[FilterDefinition]
        , [Reads],[Writes],[PageCount],[IndexSizeMB]
        , [KeyColumns], ISNULL([IncludeColumns], N'')
    FROM ic;

    CREATE TABLE #pairs
    (
          [SchemaName] SYSNAME NOT NULL
        , [ObjectName] SYSNAME NOT NULL

        , [KeepIndexName] SYSNAME NOT NULL
        , [KeepIndexId] INT NOT NULL
        , [KeepIndexTypeDesc] NVARCHAR(60) NULL
        , [KeepIsUnique] BIT NOT NULL
        , [KeepIsPrimaryKey] BIT NOT NULL
        , [KeepKeyColumns] NVARCHAR(MAX) NULL
        , [KeepIncludeColumns] NVARCHAR(MAX) NULL
        , [KeepReads] BIGINT NULL
        , [KeepWrites] BIGINT NULL
        , [KeepPageCount] BIGINT NULL
        , [KeepIndexSizeMB] DECIMAL(19,2) NULL

        , [RedundantIndexName] SYSNAME NOT NULL
        , [RedundantIndexId] INT NOT NULL
        , [RedundantIndexTypeDesc] NVARCHAR(60) NULL
        , [RedundantIsUnique] BIT NOT NULL
        , [RedundantIsPrimaryKey] BIT NOT NULL
        , [RedundantKeyColumns] NVARCHAR(MAX) NULL
        , [RedundantIncludeColumns] NVARCHAR(MAX) NULL
        , [RedundantReads] BIGINT NULL
        , [RedundantWrites] BIGINT NULL
        , [RedundantPageCount] BIGINT NULL
        , [RedundantIndexSizeMB] DECIMAL(19,2) NULL

        , [OverlapType] NVARCHAR(30) NOT NULL
        , [ConfidenceScore] INT NOT NULL
        , [Reason] NVARCHAR(max) NULL
    );

    INSERT #pairs
    (
          [SchemaName],[ObjectName]
        , [KeepIndexName],[KeepIndexId],[KeepIndexTypeDesc],[KeepIsUnique],[KeepIsPrimaryKey]
        , [KeepKeyColumns],[KeepIncludeColumns],[KeepReads],[KeepWrites],[KeepPageCount],[KeepIndexSizeMB]
        , [RedundantIndexName],[RedundantIndexId],[RedundantIndexTypeDesc],[RedundantIsUnique],[RedundantIsPrimaryKey]
        , [RedundantKeyColumns],[RedundantIncludeColumns],[RedundantReads],[RedundantWrites],[RedundantPageCount],[RedundantIndexSizeMB]
        , [OverlapType],[ConfidenceScore],[Reason]
    )
    SELECT
          a.[SchemaName]
        , a.[ObjectName]

        , [KeepIndexName] = a.[IndexName]
        , [KeepIndexId] = a.[IndexId]
        , [KeepIndexTypeDesc] = a.[IndexTypeDesc]
        , [KeepIsUnique] = a.[IsUnique]
        , [KeepIsPrimaryKey] = a.[IsPrimaryKey]
        , [KeepKeyColumns] = a.[KeyColumns]
        , [KeepIncludeColumns] = a.[IncludeColumns]
        , [KeepReads] = a.[Reads]
        , [KeepWrites] = a.[Writes]
        , [KeepPageCount] = a.[PageCount]
        , [KeepIndexSizeMB] = a.[IndexSizeMB]

        , [RedundantIndexName] = b.[IndexName]
        , [RedundantIndexId] = b.[IndexId]
        , [RedundantIndexTypeDesc] = b.[IndexTypeDesc]
        , [RedundantIsUnique] = b.[IsUnique]
        , [RedundantIsPrimaryKey] = b.[IsPrimaryKey]
        , [RedundantKeyColumns] = b.[KeyColumns]
        , [RedundantIncludeColumns] = b.[IncludeColumns]
        , [RedundantReads] = b.[Reads]
        , [RedundantWrites] = b.[Writes]
        , [RedundantPageCount] = b.[PageCount]
        , [RedundantIndexSizeMB] = b.[IndexSizeMB]

        , [OverlapType] =
            CASE
                WHEN a.[KeyColumns] = b.[KeyColumns]
                 AND ISNULL(a.[IncludeColumns],N'') = ISNULL(b.[IncludeColumns],N'')
                THEN N'EXACT_DUPLICATE'
                WHEN a.[KeyColumns] = b.[KeyColumns]
                 AND (
                        ISNULL(a.[IncludeColumns],N'') LIKE N'%' + ISNULL(b.[IncludeColumns],N'') + N'%'
                     OR ISNULL(b.[IncludeColumns],N'') = N''
                     )
                THEN N'SAME_KEY_SUPERSET_INCLUDE'
                WHEN a.[KeyColumns] LIKE b.[KeyColumns] + N',%'
                 AND (
                        ISNULL(a.[IncludeColumns],N'') LIKE N'%' + ISNULL(b.[IncludeColumns],N'') + N'%'
                     OR ISNULL(b.[IncludeColumns],N'') = N''
                     )
                THEN N'LEFT_BASED_SUPERSET'
                ELSE N'REVIEW'
            END

        , [ConfidenceScore] =
            CASE
                WHEN a.[KeyColumns] = b.[KeyColumns]
                 AND ISNULL(a.[IncludeColumns],N'') = ISNULL(b.[IncludeColumns],N'')
                THEN 100
                WHEN a.[KeyColumns] = b.[KeyColumns]
                 AND (
                        ISNULL(a.[IncludeColumns],N'') LIKE N'%' + ISNULL(b.[IncludeColumns],N'') + N'%'
                     OR ISNULL(b.[IncludeColumns],N'') = N''
                     )
                THEN 90
                WHEN a.[KeyColumns] LIKE b.[KeyColumns] + N',%'
                 AND (
                        ISNULL(a.[IncludeColumns],N'') LIKE N'%' + ISNULL(b.[IncludeColumns],N'') + N'%'
                     OR ISNULL(b.[IncludeColumns],N'') = N''
                     )
                THEN 75
                ELSE 10
            END

        , [Reason] =
            CONCAT
            (
                N'Overlap detectado. Keep=',
                a.[IndexName],
                N' | Redundant=',
                b.[IndexName],
                N'. Keys keep=',
                ISNULL(a.[KeyColumns],N''),
                N' | Keys redundant=',
                ISNULL(b.[KeyColumns],N''),
                N'. Include keep=',
                ISNULL(a.[IncludeColumns],N''),
                N' | Include redundant=',
                ISNULL(b.[IncludeColumns],N'')
            )
    FROM #idx a
    JOIN #idx b
      ON a.[SchemaName] = b.[SchemaName]
     AND a.[ObjectName] = b.[ObjectName]
     AND a.[IndexId] <> b.[IndexId]
    WHERE
        a.[HasFilter] = 0
        AND b.[HasFilter] = 0
        AND a.[IsPrimaryKey] = 0
        AND b.[IsPrimaryKey] = 0
        AND a.[IsUnique] = 0
        AND b.[IsUnique] = 0
        AND a.[IndexTypeDesc] = b.[IndexTypeDesc]
        AND
        (
            (a.[KeyColumns] = b.[KeyColumns]
             AND ISNULL(a.[IncludeColumns],N'') = ISNULL(b.[IncludeColumns],N''))
         OR (a.[KeyColumns] = b.[KeyColumns]
             AND (
                    ISNULL(a.[IncludeColumns],N'') LIKE N'%' + ISNULL(b.[IncludeColumns],N'') + N'%'
                 OR ISNULL(b.[IncludeColumns],N'') = N''
                 ))
         OR (a.[KeyColumns] LIKE b.[KeyColumns] + N',%'
             AND (
                    ISNULL(a.[IncludeColumns],N'') LIKE N'%' + ISNULL(b.[IncludeColumns],N'') + N'%'
                 OR ISNULL(b.[IncludeColumns],N'') = N''
                 ))
        )
        AND
        (
            ISNULL(a.[Reads],0) >= ISNULL(b.[Reads],0)
            OR ISNULL(a.[IndexSizeMB],0) >= ISNULL(b.[IndexSizeMB],0)
        );

    ;WITH d AS
    (
        SELECT
            p.*,
            rn =
                ROW_NUMBER() OVER
                (
                    PARTITION BY p.[SchemaName], p.[ObjectName], p.[RedundantIndexName]
                    ORDER BY p.[ConfidenceScore] DESC, ISNULL(p.[KeepReads],0) DESC, ISNULL(p.[KeepIndexSizeMB],0) DESC
                )
        FROM #pairs p
        WHERE p.[ConfidenceScore] >= 75
    )
    SELECT *
    INTO #review
    FROM d
    WHERE rn = 1;

    IF @QueueReview = 1
    BEGIN
        MERGE Manutencao.IndexAdvisor_RedundantIndexReview AS tgt
        USING
        (
            SELECT
                  [PlanDate] = @PlanDate
                , [TargetDatabaseName] = @TargetDatabase
                , [SnapshotId] = @SnapshotId
                , [SchemaName]
                , [ObjectName]
                , [KeepIndexName]
                , [KeepIndexId]
                , [KeepIndexTypeDesc]
                , [KeepIsUnique]
                , [KeepIsPrimaryKey]
                , [KeepKeyColumns]
                , [KeepIncludeColumns]
                , [KeepReads]
                , [KeepWrites]
                , [KeepPageCount]
                , [KeepIndexSizeMB]
                , [RedundantIndexName]
                , [RedundantIndexId]
                , [RedundantIndexTypeDesc]
                , [RedundantIsUnique]
                , [RedundantIsPrimaryKey]
                , [RedundantKeyColumns]
                , [RedundantIncludeColumns]
                , [RedundantReads]
                , [RedundantWrites]
                , [RedundantPageCount]
                , [RedundantIndexSizeMB]
                , [OverlapType]
                , [ConfidenceScore]
                , [Reason]
                , [SuggestedReviewAction] = N'REVIEW'
                , [SuggestedScript] =
                    N'-- REVIEW: ndice potencialmente redundante' + CHAR(10) +
                    N'-- Keep: ' + QUOTENAME([KeepIndexName]) + CHAR(10) +
                    N'-- Redundant: ' + QUOTENAME([RedundantIndexName]) + CHAR(10) +
                    N'-- Valide antes de remover em produo' + CHAR(10) +
                    N'DROP INDEX ' + QUOTENAME([RedundantIndexName]) + N' ON ' + QUOTENAME([SchemaName]) + N'.' + QUOTENAME([ObjectName]) + N';'
            FROM #review
        ) src
          ON tgt.[PlanDate] = src.[PlanDate]
         AND tgt.[TargetDatabaseName] = src.[TargetDatabaseName]
         AND tgt.[SnapshotId] = src.[SnapshotId]
         AND tgt.[SchemaName] = src.[SchemaName]
         AND tgt.[ObjectName] = src.[ObjectName]
         AND tgt.[RedundantIndexName] = src.[RedundantIndexName]
        WHEN MATCHED THEN
            UPDATE SET
                  tgt.[KeepIndexName] = src.[KeepIndexName]
                , tgt.[KeepIndexId] = src.[KeepIndexId]
                , tgt.[KeepIndexTypeDesc] = src.[KeepIndexTypeDesc]
                , tgt.[KeepIsUnique] = src.[KeepIsUnique]
                , tgt.[KeepIsPrimaryKey] = src.[KeepIsPrimaryKey]
                , tgt.[KeepKeyColumns] = src.[KeepKeyColumns]
                , tgt.[KeepIncludeColumns] = src.[KeepIncludeColumns]
                , tgt.[KeepReads] = src.[KeepReads]
                , tgt.[KeepWrites] = src.[KeepWrites]
                , tgt.[KeepPageCount] = src.[KeepPageCount]
                , tgt.[KeepIndexSizeMB] = src.[KeepIndexSizeMB]
                , tgt.[RedundantIndexId] = src.[RedundantIndexId]
                , tgt.[RedundantIndexTypeDesc] = src.[RedundantIndexTypeDesc]
                , tgt.[RedundantIsUnique] = src.[RedundantIsUnique]
                , tgt.[RedundantIsPrimaryKey] = src.[RedundantIsPrimaryKey]
                , tgt.[RedundantKeyColumns] = src.[RedundantKeyColumns]
                , tgt.[RedundantIncludeColumns] = src.[RedundantIncludeColumns]
                , tgt.[RedundantReads] = src.[RedundantReads]
                , tgt.[RedundantWrites] = src.[RedundantWrites]
                , tgt.[RedundantPageCount] = src.[RedundantPageCount]
                , tgt.[RedundantIndexSizeMB] = src.[RedundantIndexSizeMB]
                , tgt.[OverlapType] = src.[OverlapType]
                , tgt.[ConfidenceScore] = src.[ConfidenceScore]
                , tgt.[Reason] = src.[Reason]
                , tgt.[SuggestedReviewAction] = src.[SuggestedReviewAction]
                , tgt.[SuggestedScript] = src.[SuggestedScript]
        WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
            INSERT
            (
                  [PlanDate],[TargetDatabaseName],[SnapshotId]
                , [SchemaName],[ObjectName]
                , [KeepIndexName],[KeepIndexId],[KeepIndexTypeDesc],[KeepIsUnique],[KeepIsPrimaryKey]
                , [KeepKeyColumns],[KeepIncludeColumns],[KeepReads],[KeepWrites],[KeepPageCount],[KeepIndexSizeMB]
                , [RedundantIndexName],[RedundantIndexId],[RedundantIndexTypeDesc],[RedundantIsUnique],[RedundantIsPrimaryKey]
                , [RedundantKeyColumns],[RedundantIncludeColumns],[RedundantReads],[RedundantWrites],[RedundantPageCount],[RedundantIndexSizeMB]
                , [OverlapType],[ConfidenceScore],[Reason],[SuggestedReviewAction],[SuggestedScript]
            )
            VALUES
            (
                  src.[PlanDate],src.[TargetDatabaseName],src.[SnapshotId]
                , src.[SchemaName],src.[ObjectName]
                , src.[KeepIndexName],src.[KeepIndexId],src.[KeepIndexTypeDesc],src.[KeepIsUnique],src.[KeepIsPrimaryKey]
                , src.[KeepKeyColumns],src.[KeepIncludeColumns],src.[KeepReads],src.[KeepWrites],src.[KeepPageCount],src.[KeepIndexSizeMB]
                , src.[RedundantIndexName],src.[RedundantIndexId],src.[RedundantIndexTypeDesc],src.[RedundantIsUnique],src.[RedundantIsPrimaryKey]
                , src.[RedundantKeyColumns],src.[RedundantIncludeColumns],src.[RedundantReads],src.[RedundantWrites],src.[RedundantPageCount],src.[RedundantIndexSizeMB]
                , src.[OverlapType],src.[ConfidenceScore],src.[Reason],src.[SuggestedReviewAction],src.[SuggestedScript]
            );
    END;

    IF @Debug = 1
    BEGIN
        SELECT
              [TargetDatabase] = @TargetDatabase
            , [SnapshotId] = @SnapshotId
            , [Candidates] = COUNT(*)
        FROM #review;
    END;

    SELECT
          [PlanDate] = @PlanDate
        , [TargetDatabaseName] = @TargetDatabase
        , [SnapshotId] = @SnapshotId
        , [SchemaName]
        , [ObjectName]
        , [KeepIndexName]
        , [RedundantIndexName]
        , [OverlapType]
        , [ConfidenceScore]
        , [Reason]
    FROM #review
    ORDER BY [ConfidenceScore] DESC, [SchemaName], [ObjectName], [RedundantIndexName];
END

  VERSÃO: INTEGRAÇÃO DBA / 
  FINALIDADE:
    Transformar os planos  em comandos na fila [DBA].[TarefasManutencao].

  OBJETIVO:
    1) Encontrar o último snapshot com itens pendentes/erro para índice e stats.
    2) Inserir os scripts na fila externa de execução.
    3) Marcar itens como RUNNING na fila .

  REGRAS IMPORTANTES:
    1) Só roda se não existir tarefa aberta para o banco em DBA.TarefasManutencao.
       MOTIVO:
         evitar dupla fila para o mesmo banco.

    2) Índices e stats usam o último SnapshotId com Status IN (PENDING, ERROR).
       MOTIVO:
         permitir reprocessar erro sem perder a ordem da rodada mais recente.

    3) Ordem de enfileiramento dos índices:
       - REORGANIZE primeiro
       - REBUILD depois
       - depois PriorityScore DESC
       - depois tamanho

       MOTIVO possível da regra:
         reorganize costuma ser mais leve; pode ser uma forma de começar pela ação
         menos intrusiva antes de rebuilds maiores. Isso é uma escolha operacional
         do pacote atual.

    4) Ordem de enfileiramento das stats:
       - PriorityScore DESC
       - ModificationCounter DESC

       MOTIVO:
         priorizar stats mais urgentes e com maior volume de alteração.

    5) Ao inserir em DBA.TarefasManutencao, a proc prefixa:
       USE [Banco];
       ao SuggestedScript.

       MOTIVO:
         garantir execução no contexto correto do banco alvo.
==============================================================================*/


CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE [DBA].[PC_EnfileirarManutencaoPorBanco]
(
    @targetDatabaseName SYSNAME
)
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    DECLARE
        @ultimoSnapShotIndex BIGINT = NULL,
        @ultimoSnapShotStat  BIGINT = NULL;
    DECLARE
        @idBanco BIGINT = (SELECT ID FROM dba.Banco WHERE Nome = @targetDatabaseName)

    IF NOT EXISTS
    (
        SELECT 1
        FROM [DBA].[TarefasManutencao]
        WHERE [NomeBanco] = @targetDatabaseName
          AND [DataRodou] IS NULL
    )
    BEGIN
        -- LTIMO SNAPSHOT DE INDEX
        SELECT TOP (1)
               @ultimoSnapShotIndex = Q.SnapshotId
        FROM Manutencao.IndexAdvisor_IndexPlanQueue AS Q
        WHERE Q.TargetDatabaseName = @targetDatabaseName
          AND Q.Status IN (N'PENDING', N'ERROR')
        ORDER BY Q.SnapshotId DESC;

        -- LTIMO SNAPSHOT DE STATISTIC
        SELECT TOP (1)
               @ultimoSnapShotStat = Q.SnapshotId
        FROM Manutencao.IndexAdvisor_StatsPlanQueue AS Q
        WHERE Q.TargetDatabaseName = @targetDatabaseName
          AND Q.Status IN (N'PENDING', N'ERROR')
        ORDER BY Q.SnapshotId DESC;

        -- INSERE SCRIPT DE MANUTENO DE INDEX
        IF @ultimoSnapShotIndex IS NOT NULL
        BEGIN
            INSERT INTO [DBA].[TarefasManutencao]
            (
                [IdBanco],
                [NomeBanco],
                [TipoComando],
                [Objeto],
                [Comando],
                [DataInserido],
                [DataRodou]
            )
            SELECT
                 @idBanco AS [IdBanco]
                ,@targetDatabaseName AS [NomeBanco]
                ,1 AS [TipoComando]
                ,Q.ObjectName AS [Objeto]
                ,'USE ' + QUOTENAME(@targetDatabaseName) + '; ' + Q.[SuggestedScript] AS [Comando]
                ,GETDATE() AS [DataInserido]
                ,NULL AS [DataRodou]
            FROM Manutencao.IndexAdvisor_IndexPlanQueue AS Q
            WHERE Q.TargetDatabaseName = @targetDatabaseName
              AND Q.SnapshotId = @ultimoSnapShotIndex
              AND Q.Status IN (N'PENDING', N'ERROR')
            ORDER BY
                CASE Q.Rec_Action
                    WHEN N'REORGANIZE' THEN 1
                    WHEN N'REBUILD' THEN 2
                    ELSE 3
                END,
                Q.PriorityScore DESC,
                Q.IndexSizeMB DESC;

            -- MARCA QUE J COLOCOU NA FILA DE EXECUO DE INDEX
            UPDATE Manutencao.IndexAdvisor_IndexPlanQueue
               SET Status = N'RUNNING'
            WHERE SnapshotId = @ultimoSnapShotIndex AND TargetDatabaseName = @targetDatabaseName
              AND Status IN (N'PENDING', N'ERROR');
        END;

        -- INSERE SCRIPT DE MANUTENO DE STATISTIC
        IF @ultimoSnapShotStat IS NOT NULL
        BEGIN
            INSERT INTO [DBA].[TarefasManutencao]
            (
                [IdBanco],
                [NomeBanco],
                [TipoComando],
                [Objeto],
                [Comando],
                [DataInserido],
                [DataRodou]
            )
            SELECT
                 @idBanco AS [IdBanco]
                ,@targetDatabaseName AS [NomeBanco]
                ,2 AS [TipoComando]
                ,Q.ObjectName AS [Objeto]
                ,'USE ' + QUOTENAME(@targetDatabaseName) + '; ' + Q.[SuggestedScript] AS [Comando]
                ,GETDATE() AS [DataInserido]
                ,NULL AS [DataRodou]
            FROM Manutencao.IndexAdvisor_StatsPlanQueue AS Q
            WHERE Q.TargetDatabaseName = @targetDatabaseName
              AND Q.SnapshotId = @ultimoSnapShotStat
              AND Q.Status IN (N'PENDING', N'ERROR')
            ORDER BY
                Q.PriorityScore DESC,
                Q.ModificationCounter DESC;

            -- MARCA QUE J COLOCOU NA FILA DE EXECUO DE STAT
            UPDATE Manutencao.IndexAdvisor_StatsPlanQueue
               SET Status = N'RUNNING'
            WHERE SnapshotId = @ultimoSnapShotStat AND TargetDatabaseName = @targetDatabaseName
              AND Status IN (N'PENDING', N'ERROR');
        END;
    END
END

GO

--#########################################################################################################################################
/*==============================================================================
  PROC: [DBA].[PC_SetStatusExecutadoManutencaoPorBanco]
  VERSÃO: INTEGRAÇÃO DBA / 
  FINALIDADE:
    Fechar os itens da fila  como DONE após execução externa da manutenção.

  OBJETIVO:
    1) Marcar IndexPlanQueue RUNNING -> DONE
    2) Marcar StatsPlanQueue RUNNING -> DONE
    3) Registrar ExecutedAt

  MOTIVO:
    A execução real ocorre fora da fila , via DBA.TarefasManutencao. Essa proc é
    a ponte de retorno para o estado da ferramenta.

  LIMITAÇÃO IMPORTANTE:
    Ela não diferencia sucesso parcial por item; marca por banco todos os RUNNING
    como DONE. Se futuramente houver necessidade de granularidade por comando,
    essa é uma área clara de evolução.
==============================================================================*/

/*==============================================================================
  ORDEM RECOMENDADA DE EXECUÇÃO
==============================================================================
    1) Manutencao.PC_IndexAdvisor_RunCore
       - ciclo completo de snapshot + planos + review

    2) DBA.PC_EnfileirarManutencaoPorBanco
       - envia índice e stats para fila externa

    3) Execução da DBA.TarefasManutencao
       - job externo / executor do cliente

    4) DBA.PC_SetStatusExecutadoManutencaoPorBanco
       - devolve o status para DONE na fila 

    5) Manutencao.PC_IndexAdvisor_MasterReport
       - opcional para auditoria / relatório

    6) Manutencao.PC_IndexAdvisor_CleanupHistory
       - execução periódica de housekeeping
==============================================================================*/

/*==============================================================================
  PONTOS DE EVOLUÇÃO RECOMENDADOS PARA A 
==============================================================================
    1) Documentar dentro da própria PC_IndexAdvisor_GenerateIndexPlan o bloco
       adaptativo em maior detalhe, com variáveis e efeitos esperados.

    2) Adicionar documentação explícita para a escala de PriorityScore de índice,
       tal como já foi feito para stats.

    3) Evoluir PC_SetStatusExecutadoManutencaoPorBanco para receber retorno por
       item/comando, caso o executor externo permita.

    4) Se desejado, migrar toda essa documentação para o cabeçalho real de cada
       proc dentro do script principal, para manter código e regra no mesmo lugar.
==============================================================================*/


CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE [DBA].[PC_SetStatusExecutadoManutencaoPorBanco]
(
    @targetDatabaseName SYSNAME
)
AS
BEGIN
UPDATE Manutencao.IndexAdvisor_IndexPlanQueue
            SET
                  Status = N'DONE'
                , ExecutedAt = SYSDATETIME()
            WHERE Status = 'RUNNING' AND TargetDatabaseName = @targetDatabaseName;
     
            UPDATE Manutencao.IndexAdvisor_StatsPlanQueue
            SET
                  Status = N'DONE'
                , ExecutedAt = SYSDATETIME()
             WHERE Status = 'RUNNING' AND TargetDatabaseName = @targetDatabaseName;
END

--#########################################################################################################################################
/*==============================================================================
  PROC: [Manutencao].[PC_ExecutarManutencaoMultiEmpresa]
  VERSÃO: INTEGRAÇÃO DBA /
  FINALIDADE:
    Executar os comandos de manutenção pendentes (índices e estatísticas) para
    todos os bancos de dados configurados, respeitando a janela de horário
    definida por empresa.

  OBJETIVO:
    1) Validar se a execução está dentro da janela de horário permitida
    2) Iterar via cursor sobre todos os comandos pendentes em DBA.TarefasManutencao
    3) Executar cada comando via sp_executesql
    4) Registrar sucesso ou erro em tabelas de controle
    5) Limpar registros já executados da fila
    6) Atualizar ConfiguracaoJob e chamar PC_SetStatusExecutadoManutencaoPorBanco

  PARÂMETROS:
    @horaInicio TIME  - Início da janela de execução permitida (padrão: 22:00:00)
    @horaFim    TIME  - Fim da janela de execução permitida    (padrão: 05:00:00)

  MOTIVO:
    Centraliza a execução dos comandos gerados pelo advisor, garantindo que
    operações de manutenção (REINDEX, UPDATE STATISTICS, etc.) ocorram apenas
    dentro do horário de menor impacto ao ambiente produtivo.

  FLUXO INTERNO:
    1) Verifica horário via DBA.FN_ValidaHoraPodeRodar
    2) Abre cursor sobre DBA.TarefasManutencao WHERE DataRodou IS NULL
    3) Para cada registro:
       a) Revalida o horário a cada iteração
       b) Executa @comando via sp_executesql
       c) Marca DataRodou = GETDATE() em caso de sucesso ou erro
       d) Em caso de erro, insere log em DBA.TarefasManutencaoErro
    4) Após o cursor, deleta registros com DataRodou IS NOT NULL
    5) Insere resumo em DBA.TarefasManutencaoSucesso
    6) Atualiza DBA.ConfiguracaoJob.Rodou = 1
    7) Chama DBA.PC_SetStatusExecutadoManutencaoPorBanco para fechar a fila

  LIMITAÇÃO IMPORTANTE:
    Em caso de erro por comando, a proc marca o registro como executado mesmo
    assim, para evitar reprocessamento infinito. O detalhe do erro é preservado
    em DBA.TarefasManutencaoErro para análise posterior.
==============================================================================*/

CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE [Manutencao].[PC_ExecutarManutencaoMultiEmpresa] 
@HoraInicio TIME = '22:00:00', @HoraFim TIME = '05:00:00', @NomeBanco NVARCHAR(128) = NULL, @IdBanco BIGINT = NULL
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    
    DECLARE @id BIGINT;
    DECLARE @tipoComando BIGINT;
    DECLARE @objeto NVARCHAR(255);
    DECLARE @comando NVARCHAR(MAX);
    DECLARE @horaAtual TIME;
  
    DECLARE @erro NVARCHAR(MAX);
    DECLARE @totalExecutados INT = 0;
    
    -- Verificar se está dentro do horário permitido
    SET @horaAtual = CAST(GETDATE() AS TIME);
    
    -- Lógica para verificar se está dentro da janela de execução
    IF DBA.FN_ValidaHoraPodeRodar(@horaInicio, @horaFim) = 0
    BEGIN
        PRINT 'Fora do horário permitido (' + CAST(@horaAtual AS VARCHAR(8)) + '). A execução é permitida entre ' + 
              CAST(@horaInicio AS VARCHAR(8)) + ' e ' + CAST(@horaFim AS VARCHAR(8)) + '.';
        RETURN;
    END
      
    -- CURSOR para processar comandos pendentes
    DECLARE cursor_comandos CURSOR FAST_FORWARD FOR
    SELECT Id, TipoComando, Objeto, Comando, NomeBanco, IdBanco
    FROM [DBA].[TarefasManutencao]  
    WHERE DataRodou IS NULL

    OPEN cursor_comandos;
    FETCH NEXT FROM cursor_comandos INTO @id, @tipoComando, @objeto, @comando, @nomeBanco, @IdBanco;
    
    WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
    BEGIN
        -- Verificar se ainda está dentro do horário permitido
        SET @horaAtual = CAST(GETDATE() AS TIME);
        
        -- Verificar novamente se ainda está dentro da janela de execução
        IF DBA.FN_ValidaHoraPodeRodar(@horaInicio, @horaFim) = 0
        BEGIN
            PRINT 'Horário limite atingido (' + CAST(@horaAtual AS VARCHAR(8)) + '). Parando execução.';
            BREAK;
        END
        
        BEGIN TRY
            -- Executar o comando                     
			EXEC sp_executesql @comando;
            
            -- Marcar como executado
            UPDATE [DBA].[TarefasManutencao]  
            SET DataRodou = GETDATE() 
            WHERE Id = @id;
            
            SET @totalExecutados = @totalExecutados + 1;
            
            PRINT 'Sucesso: ' + @objeto;
            
        END TRY
        BEGIN CATCH
            SET @erro = ERROR_MESSAGE();
            PRINT 'ERRO ao executar ' + @objeto + ': ' + @erro;
            
            -- Marcar como executado mesmo com erro para não tentar novamente
            UPDATE [DBA].[TarefasManutencao]  
            SET DataRodou = GETDATE() 
            WHERE Id = @id;
            
            INSERT INTO [DBA].[TarefasManutencaoErro] (NomeBanco, Comando, Erro, DataInserido)
            VALUES (@nomeBanco, @comando, @erro, GETDATE());

        END CATCH

        FETCH NEXT FROM cursor_comandos INTO @id, @tipoComando, @objeto, @comando, @nomeBanco, @IdBanco;
    END
    
    CLOSE cursor_comandos;
    DEALLOCATE cursor_comandos;
    
    PRINT 'Processo finalizado. Total de comandos executados: ' + CAST(@totalExecutados AS VARCHAR(10));
    
    -- Limpar registros executados
    DECLARE @registrosLimpos INT;
    DELETE FROM [DBA].[TarefasManutencao] WHERE DataRodou IS NOT NULL;
    SET @registrosLimpos = @@ROWCOUNT;
    
    PRINT 'Registros limpos da tabela: ' + CAST(@registrosLimpos AS VARCHAR(10));

	INSERT INTO [DBA].[TarefasManutencaoSucesso] (NomeBanco, RegistrosLimpos, TotalExecutados) 
	VALUES (@nomeBanco, COALESCE(@registrosLimpos,0), COALESCE(@totalExecutados,0))

	UPDATE [DBA].[ConfiguracaoJob]  SET Rodou = 1 WHERE IdBanco = @IdBanco
    EXEC [DBA].[PC_SetStatusExecutadoManutencaoPorBanco] @targetDatabaseName = @nomeBanco; 
END

GO

--#########################################################################################################################################
/*==============================================================================
  PROC: [Manutencao].[PC_ProcessaManutencaoMultiEmpresa]
  VERSÃO: INTEGRAÇÃO DBA /
  FINALIDADE:
    Orquestrar o ciclo completo de manutenção de índices e estatísticas para
    todos os bancos de dados ativos e ainda não processados no dia corrente.

  OBJETIVO:
    1) Popular a configuração de bancos via DBA.PC_PopularBancoConfiguracao
    2) Iterar sobre cada banco ativo e pendente (Rodou = 0, AtivoManutencao = 1)
    3) Para cada banco, executar a sequência completa de manutenção:
       a) PC_IndexAdvisor_RunCore      — snapshot + planos + review
       b) PC_EnfileirarManutencaoPorBanco — gera fila de execução
       c) PC_ExecutarManutencaoMultiEmpresa — executa os comandos na janela
    4) Ao final do ciclo, resetar o flag Rodou para os bancos processados,
       preparando para a próxima execução agendada

  MOTIVO:
    Ponto de entrada único (entry point) do processo de manutenção agendada.
    Permite que um único job chame esta proc e ela mesma distribua o trabalho
    por empresa/banco de forma controlada e rastreável.

  FLUXO INTERNO:
    1) Chama DBA.PC_PopularBancoConfiguracao para garantir configuração atualizada
    2) Carrega em @BancosParaProcessar os bancos elegíveis
    3) Abre cursor sobre esses bancos
    4) Para cada banco:
       a) Valida existência e acessibilidade via DB_ID e sys.databases
       b) Executa os 3 passos de manutenção via sp_executesql com parâmetros
       c) Em caso de banco inacessível: loga erro e desativa AtivoManutencao
    5) Após o cursor, reseta Rodou = 0 apenas quando não há mais bancos pendentes

  PARÂMETROS:
    Nenhum parâmetro externo. Os parâmetros de janela de horário e comportamento
    de manutenção (RealizaReindex, RealizaUpdateStatics, etc.) são lidos
    diretamente de DBA.ConfiguracaoJob por banco.

  LIMITAÇÃO IMPORTANTE:
    Os flags RealizaRecompile, RealizaReindex, RealizaUpdateStatics e
    RealizaCompressaoIndices são lidos da configuração mas atualmente repassados
    apenas via cursor; a granularidade de uso desses flags dentro da execução
    depende da implementação de PC_IndexAdvisor_RunCore. Ponto de evolução futura.
==============================================================================*/

CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE [Manutencao].[PC_ProcessaManutencaoMultiEmpresa] 
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    -- Tabela temporária para armazenar os bancos de dados a serem processados
    DECLARE @BancosParaProcessar TABLE (
        IdBanco BIGINT PRIMARY KEY,
        NomeBanco NVARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
		HoraInicio TIME,
		HoraFim TIME,
		RealizaRecompile BIT,
		RealizaReindex BIT,
		RealizaUpdateStatics BIT,
		RealizaCompressaoIndices BIT
    );
	
	 EXEC DBA.PC_PopularBancoConfiguracao;

    -- Popula a tabela temporária com os bancos de dados da configuração
    INSERT INTO @BancosParaProcessar (IdBanco, NomeBanco, HoraInicio, HoraFim, RealizaRecompile, RealizaReindex, RealizaUpdateStatics, RealizaCompressaoIndices)
    SELECT DISTINCT C.IdBanco, B.Nome, C.HoraInicio, C.horaFim, C.RealizaRecompile, C.RealizaReindex, C.RealizaUpdateStatics, c.RealizaCompressaoIndices
    FROM [DBA].[ConfiguracaoJob] C
    INNER JOIN [DBA].[Banco] B ON C.IdBanco = B.Id
	INNER JOIN sys.databases D ON B.Nome = D.name
    WHERE C.AtivoManutencao = 1 AND C.Rodou = 0 AND D.state = 0

    -- Cursor para processar cada banco de dados
    DECLARE @bancoAtual NVARCHAR(128);
    DECLARE @IdBanco BIGINT;
    DECLARE @comandoSQL NVARCHAR(MAX);
	DECLARE @HoraInicio TIME, @HoraFim TIME;
	DECLARE @RealizaRecompile BIT,  @RealizaReindex BIT,  @RealizaUpdateStatics BIT, @RealizaCompressaoIndices BIT;
    DECLARE @data DATE = CONVERT(date, GETDATE());
    DECLARE @ManutencaoDatabase  SYSNAME = 'DBA_MetaManutencao';

    DECLARE cursor_bancos CURSOR FAST_FORWARD FOR 
    SELECT IdBanco, NomeBanco, HoraInicio, HoraFim, RealizaRecompile, RealizaReindex, RealizaUpdateStatics, RealizaCompressaoIndices
    FROM @BancosParaProcessar;

    OPEN cursor_bancos;
    FETCH NEXT FROM cursor_bancos INTO @IdBanco, @BancoAtual, @HoraInicio, @HoraFim, @RealizaRecompile,  @RealizaReindex,  @RealizaUpdateStatics, @RealizaCompressaoIndices;

    WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
    BEGIN
        IF DB_ID(@bancoAtual) IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys.databases WHERE name = @bancoAtual)
        BEGIN
            PRINT '========================================';
            PRINT 'INICIANDO PROCESSO DE MANUTENÇÃO COMPLETO';
            PRINT 'Banco de Dados: ' + @bancoAtual;
            PRINT 'Data/Hora: ' + CAST(GETDATE() AS VARCHAR(20));
            PRINT '========================================';


			-- Passo 1: Popular a tabela de manutenção
			SET @comandoSQL = N'EXEC Manutencao.PC_IndexAdvisor_RunCore @TargetDatabase, @ManutencaoDatabase, @IsBusinessHours, @UsePhysicalStatsMode, @CollectOperationalStats,  @PlanDate, @QueuePlan, @QueueRedundantReview, @Debug';

			EXEC sp_executesql @comandoSQL, N'@TargetDatabase SYSNAME, @ManutencaoDatabase SYSNAME, @IsBusinessHours BIT, @UsePhysicalStatsMode NVARCHAR(10), @CollectOperationalStats BIT, @PlanDate DATE, @QueuePlan BIT, @QueueRedundantReview BIT, @Debug BIT'
			, @TargetDatabase = @bancoAtual, @ManutencaoDatabase = @ManutencaoDatabase, @IsBusinessHours = 0, @UsePhysicalStatsMode = N'SAMPLED', @CollectOperationalStats = 0, @PlanDate = @data , @QueuePlan = 1, @QueueRedundantReview = 1, @Debug = 0  ;

			  -- Passo 2: Popular a tabela execucao
			SET @comandoSQL = N'EXEC DBA.PC_EnfileirarManutencaoPorBanco @targetDatabaseName';

			EXEC sp_executesql @comandoSQL, N'@targetDatabaseName SYSNAME'
			, @targetDatabaseName = @bancoAtual;

            -- Passo 3: Executar a manutenção
            SET @comandoSQL = N'EXEC Manutencao.PC_ExecutarManutencaoMultiEmpresa @HoraInicio, @HoraFim, @NomeBanco, @IdBanco';

			EXEC sp_executesql @comandoSQL,  N'@HoraInicio TIME, @HoraFim TIME, @NomeBanco SYSNAME, @IdBanco BIGINT', @HoraInicio = @HoraInicio, @HoraFim = @HoraFim, @NomeBanco = @bancoAtual, @IdBanco = @IdBanco;

            PRINT '========================================';
            PRINT 'PROCESSO DE MANUTENÇÃO FINALIZADO';
            PRINT 'Data/Hora: ' + CAST(GETDATE() AS VARCHAR(20));
            PRINT '========================================';
        END
        ELSE
        BEGIN
            PRINT 'AVISO: O banco de dados ' + @bancoAtual + ' não existe ou não está acessível.';
			INSERT INTO [DBA].[TarefasManutencaoErro] (NomeBanco, Comando, Erro, DataInserido)
            VALUES (@bancoAtual, 'INICIAR PROCESSO DE MANUTENÇÃO COMPLETO ', 'Banco não existe ou não está acessível.', GETDATE());

			UPDATE [DBA].[ConfiguracaoJob] SET AtivoManutencao = 0 Where IdBanco = @IdBanco
        END

        FETCH NEXT FROM cursor_bancos INTO @IdBanco, @bancoAtual, @HoraInicio, @HoraFim, @RealizaRecompile,  @RealizaReindex,  @RealizaUpdateStatics, @RealizaCompressaoIndices;
    END

    CLOSE cursor_bancos;
    DEALLOCATE cursor_bancos;

	UPDATE [DBA].[ConfiguracaoJob]
	SET RODOU = 0
	WHERE RODOU <> 0
	AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM [DBA].[ConfiguracaoJob]
      WHERE RODOU = 0 AND AtivoManutencao = 1)
END

scripts.name: Monitorar latência de disco
scripts.content:
SELECT
    DB_NAME(fs.database_id) AS [Database Name],
    mf.physical_name,
    fs.io_stall_read_ms,
    fs.num_of_reads,
    -- Média de latência de leitura em ms
    CASE WHEN fs.num_of_reads = 0 THEN 0
         ELSE fs.io_stall_read_ms / fs.num_of_reads END AS [Avg Read Stall (ms)],
    fs.io_stall_write_ms,
    fs.num_of_writes,
    -- Média de latência de escrita em ms
    CASE WHEN fs.num_of_writes = 0 THEN 0
         ELSE fs.io_stall_write_ms / fs.num_of_writes END AS [Avg Write Stall (ms)],
    fs.io_stall_read_ms + fs.io_stall_write_ms AS [Total IO Stall (ms)],
    fs.num_of_reads + fs.num_of_writes AS [Total IOs]
FROM
    sys.dm_io_virtual_file_stats(NULL, NULL) AS fs
INNER JOIN
    sys.master_files AS mf ON fs.database_id = mf.database_id AND fs.file_id = mf.file_id
ORDER BY
    [Total IO Stall (ms)] DESC;

scripts.name: Objetos modificados recentemente
scripts.content:
SELECT TOP (100)
    SCHEMA_NAME(o.schema_id) AS SchemaName,
    o.name AS Objeto,
    o.type_desc AS Tipo,
    o.modify_date AS UltimaAlteracao
FROM sys.objects o
WHERE o.is_ms_shipped = 0
ORDER BY o.modify_date DESC;

scripts.name: Permissões dos usuários do banco
scripts.content:
SELECT
    dp.name AS Principal,
    dp.type_desc AS TipoPrincipal,
    perm.permission_name AS Permissao,
    perm.state_desc AS Estado,
    OBJECT_SCHEMA_NAME(perm.major_id) AS SchemaName,
    OBJECT_NAME(perm.major_id) AS Objeto
FROM sys.database_principals dp
LEFT JOIN sys.database_permissions perm ON perm.grantee_principal_id = dp.principal_id
WHERE dp.type IN ('S', 'U', 'G', 'R')
ORDER BY dp.name, perm.permission_name;

scripts.name: Sessões inativas conectadas
scripts.content:
SELECT
    session_id,
    login_name,
    host_name,
    program_name,
    login_time,
    last_request_end_time,
    DATEDIFF(MINUTE, last_request_end_time, GETDATE()) AS MinutosInativo

scripts.name: Sugerir desfragmentação de índices
scripts.content:
SELECT 
    OBJECT_NAME(ips.object_id) AS table_name,
    i.name AS index_name,
    i.type_desc AS index_type,
    ips.avg_fragmentation_in_percent,
    ips.fragment_count,
    ips.page_count,
    ips.record_count,
    ips.avg_page_space_used_in_percent,
    CASE 
        WHEN ips.avg_fragmentation_in_percent <= 5 THEN 'Bom'
        WHEN ips.avg_fragmentation_in_percent <= 30 THEN 'Reorganizar'
        ELSE 'Reconstruir'
    END AS recomendacao,
    -- SCRIPT AUTOMATIZADO:
    CASE 
        WHEN ips.avg_fragmentation_in_percent <= 5 THEN 
            '-- Índice OK'
        WHEN ips.avg_fragmentation_in_percent <= 30 THEN 
            'ALTER INDEX [' + i.name + '] ON ' + OBJECT_NAME(ips.object_id) + ' REORGANIZE;'
        ELSE 
            'ALTER INDEX [' + i.name + '] ON '+OBJECT_NAME(ips.object_id) +' REBUILD;'
    END AS script_execucao
FROM sys.dm_db_index_physical_stats(DB_ID(), OBJECT_ID('FIN_ALancamentoFinanceiro'), NULL, NULL, 'DETAILED') ips
JOIN sys.indexes i ON ips.object_id = i.object_id AND ips.index_id = i.index_id
WHERE ips.index_id > 0 
  AND ips.page_count > 10 
ORDER BY ips.avg_fragmentation_in_percent DESC

scripts.name: Tabelas maiores do banco atual
scripts.content:
SELECT TOP (50)
    SCHEMA_NAME(t.schema_id) AS SchemaName,
    t.name AS Tabela,
    SUM(p.rows) AS Linhas,
    SUM(a.total_pages) * 8.0 / 1024 AS TamanhoMB,
    SUM(a.used_pages) * 8.0 / 1024 AS UsadoMB
FROM sys.tables t
JOIN sys.indexes i ON i.object_id = t.object_id
JOIN sys.partitions p ON p.object_id = i.object_id AND p.index_id = i.index_id
JOIN sys.allocation_units a ON a.container_id = p.partition_id
GROUP BY t.schema_id, t.name
ORDER BY TamanhoMB DESC;

scripts.name: Teste de migração
TOP 10 processos por uso de CPU
scripts.content:
SELECT TOP 10
    r.session_id,
    s.login_name,
    r.cpu_time AS CPU_ms,
    r.total_elapsed_time AS Tempo_Total_ms,
    r.logical_reads,
    r.reads,
    r.writes,
    DB_NAME(r.database_id) AS Banco,
    SUBSTRING(t.text,
        (r.statement_start_offset / 2) + 1,
        ((CASE r.statement_end_offset
            WHEN -1 THEN DATALENGTH(t.text)
            ELSE r.statement_end_offset
        END - r.statement_start_offset) / 2) + 1) AS Query
FROM sys.dm_exec_requests r
JOIN sys.dm_exec_sessions s ON r.session_id = s.session_id
CROSS APPLY sys.dm_exec_sql_text(r.sql_handle) t
ORDER BY r.cpu_time DESC;

scripts.name: TOP 20 índices mais fragmentados
scripts.content:
SELECT TOP 20
    DB_NAME() AS database_name,
    OBJECT_SCHEMA_NAME(ips.object_id) AS schema_name,
    OBJECT_NAME(ips.object_id) AS table_name,
    i.name AS index_name,
    i.type_desc AS index_type,
    ips.avg_fragmentation_in_percent,
    ips.fragment_count,
    ips.page_count,
    ips.record_count,
    ips.avg_page_space_used_in_percent,
    CASE 
        WHEN ips.avg_fragmentation_in_percent <= 5 THEN 'Bom'
        WHEN ips.avg_fragmentation_in_percent <= 30 THEN 'Reorganizar'
        ELSE 'Reconstruir'
    END AS recomendacao,
    -- SCRIPT AUTOMATIZADO:
    CASE 
        WHEN ips.avg_fragmentation_in_percent <= 5 THEN 
            '-- Índice OK (Fragmentação: ' + CAST(ROUND(ips.avg_fragmentation_in_percent, 2) AS VARCHAR(10)) + '%)'
        WHEN ips.avg_fragmentation_in_percent <= 30 THEN 
            'ALTER INDEX [' + i.name + '] ON [' + OBJECT_SCHEMA_NAME(ips.object_id) + '].[' + OBJECT_NAME(ips.object_id) + '] REORGANIZE;'

scripts.name: Último backup completo por banco
scripts.content:
SELECT
    d.name AS Banco,
    MAX(CASE WHEN bs.type = 'D' THEN bs.backup_finish_date END) AS UltimoBackupCompleto,
    MAX(CASE WHEN bs.type = 'I' THEN bs.backup_finish_date END) AS UltimoBackupDiferencial,
    MAX(CASE WHEN bs.type = 'L' THEN bs.backup_finish_date END) AS UltimoBackupLog
FROM sys.databases d
LEFT JOIN msdb.dbo.backupset bs
    ON bs.database_name = d.name
GROUP BY d.name
ORDER BY UltimoBackupCompleto;

scripts.name: Verificar bancos offline
scripts.content:
SELECT 
    DER.session_id AS [IdSessao],
    COALESCE(DB_NAME(s.database_id), 'N/A') AS [NomeBanco],
    DER.command AS [TipoComando],
    CASE 
        WHEN DER.status = 'background' THEN 'Recuperação em andamento'
        ELSE DER.status 
    END AS [Status],
	DER.percent_complete AS [Progresso_%],
    -- Formato hh:mi:ss:mmm
    CONVERT(VARCHAR(20), DATEADD(ms, DER.estimated_completion_time, 0), 114) AS [TempoRestante_Estimado],
    DATEADD(ms, DER.estimated_completion_time, GETDATE()) AS [DataHora_Termino_Estimado],
    CONVERT(VARCHAR(20), DATEADD(ms, DER.total_elapsed_time, 0), 114) AS [TempoDecorrido], 
    DER.start_time AS [DataHora_Inicio],
    DER.blocking_session_id AS [Sessao_Bloqueadora],
    DER.wait_type AS [Tipo_Espera],
    DER.wait_time AS [Tempo_Espera_ms],
    DER.last_wait_type AS [Ultimo_Tipo_Espera],
    DER.wait_resource AS [Recurso_Espera],
    DER.cpu_time AS [Tempo_CPU_ms],

    -- Conversões para MB (páginas * 8KB => MB = páginas / 128)
    CAST(DER.logical_reads / 128.0 AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS [Leitura_Logica_MB],
    CAST(DER.reads         / 128.0 AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS [Leitura_Fisica_MB],
    CAST(DER.writes        / 128.0 AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS [Gravacao_MB],

    SUBSTRING(
        REPLACE(REPLACE(
            REPLACE(SUBSTRING(
                qt.text, 
                (DER.statement_start_offset/2)+1, 
                (
                    (CASE DER.statement_end_offset
                        WHEN -1 THEN DATALENGTH(qt.text)
                        ELSE DER.statement_end_offset
                    END - DER.statement_start_offset)/2
                ) + 1
            ), CHAR(10), ' '), CHAR(13), ' '), '  ', ' '), 
        1, 1000) AS [Comando_Atual]
FROM 
    sys.dm_exec_requests AS DER
LEFT JOIN 
    sys.dm_exec_sessions AS s 
        ON DER.session_id = s.session_id
OUTER APPLY 
    sys.dm_exec_sql_text(DER.sql_handle) AS qt
WHERE 
    DER.command IN ('DB STARTUP', 'RECOVERY', 'ROLLBACK', 'BACKUP', 'RESTORE', 'DBCC')
    AND DER.percent_complete > 0
ORDER BY 
    DER.start_time DESC;

scripts.name: Verificar comandos de uma sessão
scripts.content:
DECLARE @SPID INT = 208  -- <<<< ALTERE AQUI O ID DO PROCESSO

-- Informações básicas do processo
SELECT 
    s.session_id AS [SPID],
    s.login_name AS [Login],
    s.host_name AS [Host],
    s.program_name AS [Programa],
    s.status AS [Status],
    s.cpu_time AS [Tempo_CPU_ms],
    s.memory_usage AS [Uso_Memoria_8KB],
    s.total_elapsed_time AS [Tempo_Decorrido_ms],
    s.reads AS [Leituras],
    s.writes AS [Escritas],
    s.logical_reads AS [Leituras_Logicas],
    DB_NAME(r.database_id) AS [Database],
    r.command AS [Comando],
    r.wait_type AS [Tipo_Espera],
    r.wait_time AS [Tempo_Espera_ms],
    r.blocking_session_id AS [Bloqueado_Por],
    r.open_transaction_count AS [Transacoes_Abertas],
    r.percent_complete AS [Percentual_Completo]
FROM sys.dm_exec_sessions s
LEFT JOIN sys.dm_exec_requests r ON s.session_id = r.session_id
WHERE s.session_id = @SPID;

-- Query que está sendo executada
SELECT 
    s.session_id AS [SPID],
    SUBSTRING(qt.text, 
        (r.statement_start_offset/2) + 1,
        ((CASE r.statement_end_offset
            WHEN -1 THEN DATALENGTH(qt.text)
            ELSE r.statement_end_offset
        END - r.statement_start_offset)/2) + 1
    ) AS [Query_Atual],
    qt.text AS [Query_Completa],
    qp.query_plan AS [Plano_Execucao]
FROM sys.dm_exec_sessions s
INNER JOIN sys.dm_exec_requests r ON s.session_id = r.session_id
CROSS APPLY sys.dm_exec_sql_text(r.sql_handle) qt
CROSS APPLY sys.dm_exec_query_plan(r.plan_handle) qp
WHERE s.session_id = @SPID;

-- Locks do processo
SELECT 
    resource_type AS [Tipo_Recurso],
    resource_database_id AS [Database_ID],
    DB_NAME(resource_database_id) AS [Database],
    resource_description AS [Descricao],
    request_mode AS [Modo_Lock],
    request_status AS [Status_Lock]
FROM sys.dm_tran_locks
WHERE request_session_id = @SPID;

-- Últimas queries executadas pela sessão
SELECT TOP 5
    s.session_id AS [SPID],
    s.login_name AS [Login],
    st.text AS [Query],
    qs.execution_count AS [Execucoes],
    qs.total_elapsed_time/1000000 AS [Tempo_Total_seg],
    qs.last_execution_time AS [Ultima_Execucao]
FROM sys.dm_exec_sessions s
INNER JOIN sys.dm_exec_connections c ON s.session_id = c.session_id
CROSS APPLY sys.dm_exec_sql_text(c.most_recent_sql_handle) st
LEFT JOIN sys.dm_exec_query_stats qs ON qs.sql_handle = c.most_recent_sql_handle
WHERE s.session_id = @SPID
ORDER BY qs.last_execution_time DESC;

scripts.name: Verificar configurações do banco

scripts.name: Verificar histórico de jobs
Verificar índices do banco
scripts.content:
WITH IndexBase AS
(
    SELECT
        s.name AS SchemaName,
        o.name AS ObjectName,
        o.type_desc AS ObjectType,
        i.name AS IndexName,
        i.object_id,
        i.index_id,
        i.type_desc AS IndexType,
        p.data_compression_desc,
        i.fill_factor,
        i.is_padded,
        i.allow_row_locks,
        i.allow_page_locks,
        SUM(a.total_pages) * 8.0 / 1024 AS TotalMB,
        SUM(p.rows) AS TotalRows
    FROM sys.indexes i
    JOIN sys.objects o
        ON o.object_id = i.object_id
    JOIN sys.schemas s
        ON s.schema_id = o.schema_id
    JOIN sys.partitions p
        ON p.object_id = i.object_id
       AND p.index_id = i.index_id
    JOIN sys.allocation_units a
        ON a.container_id = p.partition_id
    WHERE
        o.is_ms_shipped = 0
        AND i.index_id > 0
    GROUP BY
        s.name,
        o.name,
        o.type_desc,
        i.name,
        i.object_id,
        i.index_id,
        i.type_desc,
        p.data_compression_desc,
        i.fill_factor,
        i.is_padded,
        i.allow_row_locks,
        i.allow_page_locks
),
UsageBase AS
(
    SELECT
        object_id,
        index_id,
        user_seeks,
        user_scans,
        user_lookups,
        user_updates
    FROM sys.dm_db_index_usage_stats
    WHERE database_id = DB_ID()
)
SELECT
    ib.SchemaName,
    ib.ObjectName,
    ib.ObjectType,
    ib.IndexName,
    ib.IndexType,
    ib.TotalMB,
    ib.TotalRows,
    ib.data_compression_desc AS CompressaoAtual,
    ib.fill_factor,
    ib.is_padded,
    ib.allow_row_locks,
    ib.allow_page_locks,

    ISNULL(ub.user_seeks, 0) AS UserSeeks,
    ISNULL(ub.user_scans, 0) AS UserScans,
    ISNULL(ub.user_lookups, 0) AS UserLookups,
    ISNULL(ub.user_updates, 0) AS UserUpdates,

    CASE
        WHEN ISNULL(ub.user_updates, 0) >= 
             (ISNULL(ub.user_seeks, 0) + ISNULL(ub.user_scans, 0) + ISNULL(ub.user_lookups, 0)) * 2
             AND ISNULL(ub.user_updates, 0) >= 1000
            THEN 'WRITE_HEAVY'
        WHEN (ISNULL(ub.user_seeks, 0) + ISNULL(ub.user_scans, 0) + ISNULL(ub.user_lookups, 0)) >= 
             ISNULL(ub.user_updates, 0) * 2
            THEN 'READ_HEAVY'
        ELSE 'MISTO'
    END AS PerfilUso,

    CASE
        WHEN ib.TotalMB >= 1024
             AND ISNULL(ub.user_updates, 0) >= 
                 (ISNULL(ub.user_seeks, 0) + ISNULL(ub.user_scans, 0) + ISNULL(ub.user_lookups, 0)) * 2
             AND ISNULL(ub.user_updates, 0) >= 1000
            THEN 'ROW'
        WHEN ib.TotalMB >= 1024
             AND (ISNULL(ub.user_seeks, 0) + ISNULL(ub.user_scans, 0) + ISNULL(ub.user_lookups, 0)) >= 
                 ISNULL(ub.user_updates, 0) * 2
            THEN 'PAGE'
        WHEN ib.TotalMB < 128
            THEN 'NONE/ROW'
        ELSE 'ROW'
    END AS CompressaoSugeridaDiagnostico,

    CASE
        WHEN ib.data_compression_desc <> 
            CASE
                WHEN ib.TotalMB >= 1024
                     AND ISNULL(ub.user_updates, 0) >= 
                         (ISNULL(ub.user_seeks, 0) + ISNULL(ub.user_scans, 0) + ISNULL(ub.user_lookups, 0)) * 2
                     AND ISNULL(ub.user_updates, 0) >= 1000
                    THEN 'ROW'
                WHEN ib.TotalMB >= 1024
                     AND (ISNULL(ub.user_seeks, 0) + ISNULL(ub.user_scans, 0) + ISNULL(ub.user_lookups, 0)) >= 
                         ISNULL(ub.user_updates, 0) * 2
                    THEN 'PAGE'
                WHEN ib.TotalMB < 128
                    THEN ib.data_compression_desc
                ELSE 'ROW'
            END
            THEN 'DIVERGENTE'
        ELSE 'OK'
    END AS StatusDiagnostico
FROM IndexBase ib
LEFT JOIN UsageBase ub
    ON ub.object_id = ib.object_id
   AND ub.index_id = ib.index_id
ORDER BY
    ib.TotalMB DESC;

scripts.name: Verificar parâmetros de procedure em execução
scripts.content:
DECLARE @idSessao INT;

SELECT TOP (1)
    @idSessao = r.session_id,
    r.session_id,
    r.status,
    r.start_time,
    DB_NAME(r.database_id) AS Banco,
    t.text AS ComandoExecutado
FROM sys.dm_exec_requests r
CROSS APPLY sys.dm_exec_sql_text(r.sql_handle) t
WHERE t.text LIKE '%PC_NomeProcedure%'
ORDER BY r.start_time DESC;

IF @idSessao IS NOT NULL
BEGIN
    SELECT *
    FROM sys.dm_exec_input_buffer(@idSessao, NULL);
END

scripts.name: Verificar transações abertas
scripts.content:
SELECT 
    s.session_id,
    s.login_name,
    s.host_name,
    s.program_name,
    t.transaction_begin_time,
    DATEDIFF(MINUTE, t.transaction_begin_time, GETDATE()) AS minutos_aberta,
    s.status,
    r.command,
    r.wait_type,
    SUBSTRING(st.text, (r.statement_start_offset/2)+1, 
        ((CASE r.statement_end_offset WHEN -1 THEN DATALENGTH(st.text) 
          ELSE r.statement_end_offset END - r.statement_start_offset)/2)+1) AS sql_atual
FROM sys.dm_tran_active_transactions t
JOIN sys.dm_tran_session_transactions ts ON t.transaction_id = ts.transaction_id
JOIN sys.dm_exec_sessions s ON ts.session_id = s.session_id
LEFT JOIN sys.dm_exec_requests r ON s.session_id = r.session_id
OUTER APPLY sys.dm_exec_sql_text(r.sql_handle) st
ORDER BY t.transaction_begin_time ASC;


SELECT
    s.session_id                                    AS SPID,
    s.login_name,
    s.host_name,
    s.program_name,
    DB_NAME(dt.database_id)                         AS Banco,
    at.name                                         AS TransactionName,
    at.transaction_begin_time                       AS InicioTransacao,
    DATEDIFF(MINUTE, at.transaction_begin_time, GETDATE()) AS MinutosAberta,
    s.status,
    r.status                                        AS RequestStatus,
    r.command,
    r.wait_type,
    r.blocking_session_id,
    st.text                                         AS QueryExecutando
FROM sys.dm_tran_active_transactions at
INNER JOIN sys.dm_tran_session_transactions stt
    ON at.transaction_id = stt.transaction_id
INNER JOIN sys.dm_exec_sessions s
    ON stt.session_id = s.session_id
LEFT JOIN sys.dm_exec_requests r
    ON s.session_id = r.session_id
LEFT JOIN sys.dm_tran_database_transactions dt
    ON at.transaction_id = dt.transaction_id
OUTER APPLY sys.dm_exec_sql_text(r.sql_handle) st
WHERE s.session_id <> @@SPID
ORDER BY at.transaction_begin_time ASC;
